fusions.name: Raw Sweep
fusions.desc: Releases a burst of raw force that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Arc Prick
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of force along the fork into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%).

fusions.name: Drawn Candlelight
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Charged Haft
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
